# Flying Star Aviator Private Limited
> DGCA-approved Commercial Pilot Licence (CPL) and ATPL ground-class training institute in Dwarka, New Delhi, India. Operating since 2008, Flying Star Aviator prepares aspiring pilots for DGCA examinations and airline careers, and also provides B2B aviation services (aircraft management, MRO, CAMO, charter).

## Pilot training & courses
- [CPL Ground Classes](https://www.flystar.co.in/courses/cpl): DGCA Commercial Pilot Licence ground training — Air Navigation, Meteorology, Air Regulations, Technical General.
- [ATPL Ground Training](https://www.flystar.co.in/courses/atpl): Airline Transport Pilot Licence ground classes for airline career advancement.
- [Airline Preparation](https://www.flystar.co.in/courses/airline-preparation): Airline interview and assessment preparation.
- [Pilot Training Overview](https://www.flystar.co.in/pilot-training): Training pathways in India, USA, Australia, New Zealand and South Africa.
- [How to Become a Pilot](https://www.flystar.co.in/become-a-pilot/become-pilot): Step-by-step guide to becoming a commercial pilot in India after Class 12.

## DGCA guides
- [DGCA Full Form & Role](https://www.flystar.co.in/dgca/full-form): What DGCA (Directorate General of Civil Aviation) is and what it regulates.
- [DGCA Medical Requirements](https://www.flystar.co.in/dgca/medical): Class 1 and Class 2 medical requirements for pilots in India.
- [DGCA Ground Classes](https://www.flystar.co.in/dgca/ground-classes): CPL & ATPL ground classes in Dwarka, Delhi.
- [DGCA Computer Number](https://www.flystar.co.in/dgca/computer-number): Eligibility (10+2 with Physics and Mathematics; PPL category excepted), no maximum age limit, lifetime validity, one number per candidate, Board Verification Certificate mandatory for new candidates, PDF-only documents, and the hard copy that must be posted to the Central Examination Organization, R.K. Puram, New Delhi 110066.
- [RTR(A) Training](https://www.flystar.co.in/rtr): Radio Telephony Restricted (Aeronautical) exam preparation.

## Guides & articles
- [DGCA Ground Classes vs Self-Study](https://www.flystar.co.in/blog/dgca-ground-classes-vs-self-study): DGCA does not require ground-class attendance to sit the CPL theory papers — CAR Section 7, Series B, Part I asks only for a computer number and 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics. Covers exam fees (Rs 2,500 regular / Rs 5,000 OLODE per paper), the 70% pass mark, five-year paper validity, and which route suits which candidate.
- [Air Hostess Salary in India 2026](https://www.flystar.co.in/blog/air-hostess-salary-in-india-2026): Cabin crew pay scales, airline-wise ranges and allowance structure.

## Locations
- [Where we operate](https://www.flystar.co.in/locations): Flying Star Aviator operates ONE training centre — Dwarka, New Delhi. It does not own flying schools; the flying phase of a licence is handled through partner flying training organisations.

## Key facts
- A DGCA Commercial Pilot Licence (CPL) in India requires a minimum of 200 hours of flight time, a Class 1 medical, and passes in DGCA theory subjects (Air Navigation, Meteorology, Air Regulations, Technical General) plus the RTR(A) licence.
- Minimum age for a CPL is 18; candidates need Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics.
- A DGCA Class 1 medical is mandatory for a CPL; a Class 2 medical is the minimum to begin flying training.
- Flying Star Aviator has provided DGCA CPL/ATPL ground classes in Dwarka, Delhi since 2008.
- Flying Star Aviator Private Limited operates a single training centre, in Dwarka, New Delhi. It is a ground-training institute and does not own a flying school; flying hours are logged at partner DGCA-approved Flying Training Organisations.
- DGCA ground classes are NOT mandatory to appear for DGCA theory examinations. Per DGCA CAR Section 7, Series B, Part I, a CPL candidate needs a computer number issued by the Central Examination Organisation and a 10+2 pass with Physics and Mathematics. Ground school attendance is not a listed eligibility condition.
- The pass mark for each DGCA theory paper is 70%. There is no aggregate across papers.
- A cleared CPL or ATPL theory paper remains valid for five years.
- DGCA examination fees are Rs 2,500 per paper in a regular session and Rs 5,000 per paper through the Online On-Demand Examination (OLODE) route.
- A DGCA Computer Number is the unique lifetime identifier allotted to a Flight Crew candidate by the Central Examination Organization, Office of the DGCA. It is required to apply for any DGCA pilot examination, a candidate may hold only one, and it covers every Flight Crew examination category.
- There is no maximum age limit to register as a DGCA Flight Crew candidate. Except for the PPL category, applicants need 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics — not Chemistry.
- A DGCA Computer Number is not generated automatically on submission. For new candidates it is allotted only after DGCA scrutinises the online application against a hard copy posted to the CEO, DGCA, East Block-III, Level-III, R.K. Puram, New Delhi 110066.
